title: ReactJS Team Lead
description:
Lead a team of front-end developers in delivering scalable and maintainable web applications using React.js.

Own the architecture and technical decisions for complex UI features and front-end systems.

Mentor team members, conduct code reviews, and enforce development best practices.

Translate product requirements into technical specifications and timelines.

Collaborate closely with backend engineers, designers, DevOps, and QA to ensure end-to-end delivery.

Drive performance optimization, cross-browser compatibility, and responsive design.

Manage task allocation, sprint planning, and ensure timely delivery of features.

Ensure a high standard of UI/UX consistency and quality across the product.

  
  

### **Requirements**

6+ years of hands-on experience with React.js, including Hooks, Context API, and Redux.

Strong foundation in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and SCSS/SASS.

Solid experience in designing component libraries, design systems, and atomic design structures.

Familiarity with Next.js, Server-Side Rendering (SSR), and static site generation.

Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and JSON data handling.

Experience working with Webpack, Babel, and front-end build optimization.

Expertise in unit testing frameworks (Jest, React Testing Library) and integration testing.

Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, code versioning tools like Git, and tools like ESLint, Prettier.

Experience deploying and scaling front-end applications on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

Bonus: Exposure to micro frontends, performance profiling tools, and A/B testing frameworks.

title: Network and System Engineer
description:
##### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Network Design and Implementation** Design and implement local area networks (LANs), wide area networks (WANs), and other network infrastructure components based on organizational requirements. This includes configuring switches, routers, firewalls, and other networking equipment.
* **System Administration** Administer and maintain servers, including operating system installation, configuration, patching, and performance tuning. Monitor system health, diagnose and resolve system issues, and ensure system security and data integrity.
* **Network and System Troubleshooting** Identify and troubleshoot network and system issues, analyze root causes, and implement appropriate solutions in a timely manner. Collaborate with other IT team members to resolve complex technical problems.
* **Network and System Security** Implement and maintain network and system security measures, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, virtual private networks (VPNs), and other security technologies. Ensure compliance with organizational security policies and industry best practices.
* **Documentation and Reporting** Create and maintain network and system documentation, including network diagrams, system configurations, and standard operating procedures. Generate reports on network and system performance, availability, and utilization.
* **Technical Support** Provide technical support to end users, including troubleshooting and resolving network and system\-related issues. Provide timely and effective communication and assistance to end users, both remotely and onsite.
  

##### **Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* Minimum of 1 year of experience in network and system engineering or a related role.
* Strong understanding of networking concepts and protocols, such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and routing protocols.
* Hands\-on experience with networking equipment, such as switches, routers, firewalls, and wireless access points.
* Knowledge of server operating systems, such as Windows Server and Linux, and system administration tasks, including installation, configuration, patching, and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with network and system security concepts, tools, and best practices.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Strong communication and documentation skills.

title: Cloud and DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**The Role: Cloud \& DevSecOps Engineer**

Day to day, that means designing and running our infrastructure across Google Cloud Platform and AWS, owning our GitLab CI/CD pipelines, and implementing the security controls that protect PHI and financial data.

This role has a deliberate growth path. You will start as the hands\-on engineer who builds and secures the platform. Over your first year, you will work alongside the team lead and an external compliance specialist. During that time you will take on increasing ownership of our HIPAA program and SOC 2 Type II attestation, moving from implementing controls to designing and leading them. The goal is that you become our security and compliance lead. We will fund necessary training to get you there.

If you want your infrastructure and security decisions to actually matter, and you want a path from senior engineer to program owner, this is that role.

**What You'll Do**

***Cloud Architecture: GCP and AWS***

* Design, deploy, and operate our SaaS infrastructure across GCP and AWS using HIPAA\-aligned reference architectures.
* Make sure every workload touching PHI runs only on HIPAA\-eligible services. Business Associate Agreements must be signed for each cloud account and project before any PHI lands.
* Implement network segmentation and VPC design, encryption at rest and in transit, KMS key management, and least\-privilege IAM across both clouds.
* Build everything as infrastructure\-as\-code with Terraform. Environments should be reproducible, reviewable, and auditable.

***DevOps and GitLab CI/CD***

* Own and improve our GitLab CI/CD pipelines end to end: build, test, scan, deploy.
* Integrate security scanning into the pipeline (SAST, dependency and SCA scanning, container and IaC scanning) without turning delivery into a crawl.
* Manage secrets, artifacts, and release processes securely. Keep PHI out of logs, caches, and lower environments.
* Support the development team. Good pipelines make other engineers faster, not slower.

***Security Engineering***

* Implement and maintain technical safeguards: phishing\-resistant MFA, centralized audit logging, monitoring and alerting, vulnerability management, and incident response.
* Enforce bastion or VDI\-only production access with no local download of PHI, backed by DLP and egress controls.
* Keep production access minimal and regularly reviewed. Use de\-identified or synthetic data in development and test environments.
* Respond to security events and lead post\-incident reviews.

***Compliance: HIPAA, SOC 2 Type II, Plaid***

*Starting out, you implement and evidence. Over time, you design and lead.*

* Implement the technical controls behind our HIPAA Security Rule safeguards and SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria, then take ownership of the program as you grow into the role.
* Operate our compliance automation platform (Vanta, Drata, or Secureframe): keep evidence collection running, monitor for control drift, close gaps.
* Own the security side of our Plaid integration. That means TLS 1\.2\+ and mTLS where required, encrypted secrets, least\-privilege access to financial data, and monitoring for unauthorized access. You will also support Plaid's production access review and security questionnaire. Handling consumer financial data carries GLBA and FTC Safeguards Rule obligations, and you will help us meet them.
* Support penetration tests and audits: help scope them, coordinate with the testers and auditor, and drive remediation.
* Over time, you will lead the HIPAA risk analysis, own control design, select and manage the external auditor, and carry us through the SOC 2 Type II observation period.

**What You Need**

* 3\+ years in cloud engineering, DevOps, or DevSecOps.
* Hands\-on production experience on both GCP and AWS. Not one cloud plus a certification in the other: real production work in both.
* Strong GitLab CI/CD experience, or equivalent CI/CD depth and the ability to move to GitLab quickly.
* Terraform and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Practical security engineering: IAM and least privilege, encryption, secrets management, network security, logging and monitoring.
* Working exposure to HIPAA or SOC 2 in practice. You should be able to explain what a control is and how you'd evidence it.
* The judgment to handle PHI responsibly and work inside strict access controls.
* Clear written and spoken English. You will document data flows, controls, and decisions that auditors and customers read.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior work at a healthcare, fintech, or other regulated SaaS company handling sensitive data.
* Hands\-on experience with a compliance automation platform (Vanta, Drata, Secureframe, Sprinto).
* Experience integrating a financial data provider such as Plaid, and awareness of GLBA / FTC Safeguards Rule obligations.
* Any of these certifications: AWS Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Security Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Architect, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP, CCSP, CISM, HITRUST CCSFP.
* Experience working directly with external auditors or remediating penetration test findings.

**How To Apply:** Share your CV on careers@dronatechlabs.com

Pay: ₹80,000\.00 \- ₹100,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: QA Team Lead (Web Scraping & Data Extraction)
description:
**About Actowiz Solutions**
===========================


Actowiz Solutions is a leading provider of web scraping, data extraction, and market intelligence solutions. We help global enterprises collect, process, and deliver structured data from eCommerce, Quick Commerce, Retail, Travel, Food Delivery, Automotive, Real Estate, and other digital platforms.
We are looking for an experienced **QA Team Lead** who can lead a team of QA Engineers, ensure high\-quality client deliveries, improve QA processes, and collaborate closely with developers and project managers to maintain exceptional data quality across multiple web scraping projects.**Role Overview**
=================


As a QA Team Lead, you will be responsible for leading day\-to\-day QA activities across multiple web scraping and data extraction projects. You will mentor QA Engineers, establish testing standards, review deliverables, identify process improvements, and ensure that every client delivery meets the required quality benchmarks.
The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership skills, excellent analytical abilities, and hands\-on experience validating large\-scale scraped datasets.**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Team Leadership**
-------------------

* Lead, mentor, and guide a team of QA Engineers.
* Assign QA tasks and monitor daily progress.
* Conduct regular knowledge\-sharing sessions and team training.
* Review team performance and provide constructive feedback.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, and mentoring of new QA team members.

**Data Quality Assurance**
--------------------------

* Validate datasets for:
	+ Accuracy
	+ Completeness
	+ Freshness
	+ Consistency
	+ Formatting
	+ Duplicate records
* Review client deliverables before submission.
* Ensure adherence to project\-specific validation checklists and SOPs.
* Verify data against client requirements and acceptance criteria.

**Testing \& Validation**
-------------------------

* Prepare detailed test plans and test cases for scraping projects.
* Perform functional and regression testing of web scrapers and APIs.
* Validate parser outputs after website structure changes.
* Identify missing fields, incorrect mappings, duplicate records, and formatting inconsistencies.
* Perform sanity checks before production deliveries.

**Scraper Validation**
----------------------

* Test web scraping applications, crawlers, APIs, and ETL pipelines.
* Monitor scraping performance and data quality after deployments.
* Validate outputs across multiple websites and data sources.
* Coordinate with developers to resolve extraction and parsing issues.

**Process Improvement**
-----------------------

* Improve QA processes, validation methodologies, and checklists.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend preventive actions.
* Maintain documentation for QA processes and project\-specific validations.
* Drive continuous improvements in delivery quality and efficiency.

**Reporting \& Coordination**
-----------------------------

* Coordinate with Project Managers, Developers, Business Analysts, and Delivery teams.
* Track QA progress across multiple projects.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly QA reports.
* Escalate critical quality issues and project risks proactively.
* Ensure project deliveries meet defined SLAs and timelines.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3–6 years of experience in Software Testing or Quality Assurance.
* Minimum 2 years of experience leading a QA team.
* Experience working on web scraping, data extraction, or data validation projects.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and leadership skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

**Technical Skills**
====================

**Must Have**
-------------

* Strong understanding of:
	+ HTML
	+ DOM
	+ XPath
	+ CSS Selectors
	+ JSON
	+ XML
* Hands\-on experience with:
	+ SQL
	+ REST APIs
	+ Data validation techniques
* Experience testing:
	+ Web Scrapers
	+ Crawlers
	+ APIs
	+ ETL Pipelines
* Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies.
* Strong understanding of Excel and large dataset validation.

**Preferred Skills**
====================

* Basic knowledge of Python scripting for QA automation.
* Experience with distributed web scraping frameworks.
* Understanding of proxy management and anti\-bot mechanisms.
* Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP.
* Exposure to automated data validation frameworks.
* Experience in a Web Scraping, Market Intelligence, or Data\-as\-a\-Service (DaaS) company.

**Leadership Expectations**
===========================


The QA Team Lead should be capable of:* Managing a team of QA Engineers effectively.
* Handling multiple client projects simultaneously.
* Ensuring on\-time project deliveries with high quality.
* Mentoring junior QA team members.
* Coordinating effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Driving continuous process improvements within the QA function.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
=====================================

* Data Accuracy (%)
* First\-Time Right (FTR)
* Defect Leakage Rate
* Production Defects
* On\-Time Delivery
* SLA Compliance
* Team Productivity
* Quality Audit Score
* Client Acceptance Rate
* Root Cause Closure Rate
* QA Documentation Compliance
* Client Satisfaction (CSAT)

**Why Join Actowiz Solutions?**
===============================

* Work on global web scraping and market intelligence projects.
* Lead a talented and growing QA team.
* Gain exposure to cutting\-edge data extraction technologies.
* Enjoy continuous learning and career advancement opportunities.
* Be part of a collaborative, innovation\-driven work environment.

 **If you have a passion for quality, leadership, and large\-scale data validation, we would love to have you join the Actowiz Solutions team.**
